description: Defines the AnalyticsImplementation class implementing IAnalytics and IConfiguration interfaces, including event handling, backend management, and configuration for analytics in a plugin framework.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Implements analytics and configuration interfaces, manages event processing, backend loading, and system time validation within the plugin.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an analytics event with specified parameters to the backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics plugin with the provided shell.

methods.name: IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if system time is valid.

methods.name: SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Dispatches an event to the appropriate backend.

methods.name: ParseEventsMapFile
methods.description: Parses the events mapping configuration file.

methods.name: GetCurrentUptimeInMs
methods.description: Returns current system uptime in milliseconds.

methods.name: ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts uptime duration to timestamp in milliseconds.
